about_the_game:
Slaughter the enemies of Mankind as the Horde of Jaghatai with the White Scars Chapter Pack!

This DLC contains a Champion skin, a cosmetic set, three weapon skins and is available with the Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2 Season Pass.

Champion Pack:

Get a full-body, White Scars Champion skin for the Assault class.

Weapon Skin Pack:

Receive three Weapon skins for the Occulus Bolt Carbine, Stalker Bolt Rifle and Combat Knife.

Cosmetic Pack:

39 cosmetic items and heraldry markings from 8 White Scars Successor Chapters. See below.
